gold.user: As a GitHub organization admin, I want to retrieve the custom OIDC subject template for my organization so that I can understand how it is configured and ensure it meets our security requirements.
gold.ideal: The API should return the current custom OIDC subject template for the specified organization, including any placeholders or variables that are used in the template.

gold.user: As a GitHub organization admin, I want to update the custom OIDC subject template for my organization to include additional information about our users, ensuring that the subject claims align with our identity management policies.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a new custom OIDC subject template and return a success message confirming that the template has been updated for the specified organization.
